title: {{country}} National Ranking
description: Rider-only national ranking, championship qualification, National Duty and individual championship preparation. Team Ranking points are not affected.

cards.directField: Field fits directly into the final
cards.prepDescription: Equipment and individual tactics only. Staff, assets and supplies are organizer-managed.
cards.hostPendingHelp: Championship waits until two suitable routes are available.

duty.title: My National Duty
duty.description: These riders are entered automatically. You manage only each rider's equipment and individual race strategy.
duty.locked: Individual race — no team tactics. Staff, assets and club supplies are unavailable.
duty.noPlan: No editable National Duty plan is currently open for this rider.
duty.empty: None of your riders has an active National Duty invitation for this championship.

plan.equipmentHelp: Choose a club equipment setup if you want; otherwise organizer-standard equipment is used. Staff, vehicles and race supplies remain organizer-managed.

ranking.description: Based on rider race points with recency weighting. National Championship bonuses are rider-only.

results.title: Championship results
results.pending: Final results will appear automatically after the championship is calculated.

champions.title: Past champions
champions.first: The first champion will be added here automatically.

availability.climateUnavailable: No championship window above 20°C is available in the current climate data. Warmest eligible weekly maximum: {{temperature}}°C.
availability.routeMissing: This country does not currently have a suitable National Championship road stage. The championship stays paused until at least two suitable road stages exist.
availability.singleRoute: Only one suitable National Championship road stage currently exists. The championship stays paused until a second suitable route is added, so qualification and final can use different routes.
availability.windowDates: {{start}}–{{end}} · expected warm-window maximum {{temperature}}°C · no team cost.

decision.title: National Duty participation
decision.blockedWindow: This rider is provisionally blocked from club duty from {{start}} to {{end}}.
decision.rejectWarning: Refusing cancels this rider's scheduled National Duty participation and costs the rider 2 morale.
decision.participationBenefit: If the rider competes, normal race fatigue and skill development apply; finishing a National Championship race also gives +1 morale.
decision.error: Could not save the National Duty decision.
decision.rejectedMessage: {{rider}} will remain with the club and has received the refusal morale penalty.

header.subtitle: National riders, qualification and championship duties

draw.title: Championship draw
draw.projected: Projected from the current National Ranking until the ranking freeze

info.title: Championship information
info.description: National Championships are individual races. There are no team tactics, staff, vehicles or club supplies. The organizer covers logistics and cost; you control only each invited rider's equipment and individual tactics.

summary.title: National Championship schedule
summary.subtitle: Key dates, National Duty window and host route for your country's championship.

eventPage.invalid: This National Championship event is not available.
eventPage.subtitle: Individual national event. No team tactics, team applications or club race costs.
eventPage.startTimeTbd: Start time set when race is generated
eventPage.profileNote: Only the start, finish and terrain profile are used for National Championship events. There are no KOM or intermediate sprint gates.
eventPage.profileDescription: National Championship route using the selected host-country terrain profile.
eventPage.replayAfterGeneration: Replay becomes available through the normal race replay system after this National Championship race is generated and calculated.
eventPage.finalRidersPending: Final participants will be known after the qualification groups are completed.
eventPage.noRiders: No riders are currently assigned to this event.
eventPage.resultsPending: Results will be published here after the race is completed.

associationPage.title: {{country}} National Association
associationPage.description: Build your country's user-run National Association, elect the National Coach and prepare the national-team structure. There is no Association treasury: travel, staff support, vehicles, equipment and race supplies are covered by the game.

errors.action: The action could not be completed.

notEligible.title: Not eligible for this Association
notEligible.body: You need an active human-controlled main club to participate in a National Association.

join.noAssociationBody: Your country does not have an Association yet. At least {{count}} eligible club managers must support it before it becomes active.
join.joined: You are now supporting your National Association.
join.existingBody: An Association already exists for your country. Join it to vote, stand for National Coach and participate in the national-team system.

cards.coveredHelp: No treasury or club spending. National-team operating costs are system-funded.

forming.title: Association is forming
forming.body: {{count}} more eligible manager(s) are needed before this Association activates.

election.title: National Coach election
election.oneVote: One eligible Association member = one vote. Votes are secret and final for each round.
election.notOpen: No coach election is currently open.
election.manifestoPlaceholder: Explain your national-team approach, rider selection principles and goals…
election.candidacySaved: Your National Coach candidacy has been saved.
election.noCandidates: No candidates are currently available in this round.
election.voteSaved: Your vote has been submitted and cannot be changed.

nationalTeamPage.title: {{country}} National Team
nationalTeamPage.description: National Coach workspace for rider call-ups, the 10-rider squad and standardized national-team equipment.

errors.action: The action could not be completed.

clubCallups.title: National Team call-ups
clubCallups.description: Your club must accept or decline official national-team call-ups before the deadline.

riders.title: Eligible national riders
riders.description: The coach sees National Ranking, availability and a deliberately masked Overall range. Exact hidden skills and potential remain private.

squad.title: Final 10-rider squad
squad.description: Select exactly 10 riders from accepted call-ups. The 7-rider race lineups will be chosen later from this squad.
squad.noAccepted: No accepted call-ups are available yet.

package.title: Standard National Team package
package.description: Every country receives the same system-funded package. It cannot be purchased, upgraded or replaced with club equipment.

notCoach.title: National Coach controls are locked
notCoach.body: Only the elected National Coach or current caretaker can select riders and manage the national squad. Club managers can still answer call-ups for their own riders above.

messages.callupAccepted: {{rider}} has been accepted for national-team selection.
messages.squadConfirmed: The 10-rider National Team squad is confirmed.
